caveat: The held-out transmission check for Pu-240 had only one energy bin, where both this file and ENDF/B-VIII.1 are about 35 % off, so it is a weak test. Thermal capture is 2.3 % below measurement; the capture resonance integral is 7.6 % below (within the 1.5x-uncertainty gate). Statistical-fill levels are weak and their positions are not predictions.
caveat_short: measured peaks; held-out transmission check weak (1 bin)
